repair.package_load: Hash the archive incrementally and read ZIP members directly from the file.
repair.active_verify: Stream archive, canonical manifest, tensor payload, package-content hash, and signature verification without deserializing a second tensor mapping.
repair.initial_activation: Still performs complete safe-tensor deserialization, shape validation, signature validation, strict assignment, and artifact identity checks.

claim_boundary: Additive exact-host overlay for a runtime memory repair only. It does not rewrite the frozen product manifest or authorize any new product-quality claim.
